26006.text: YOU, though, are not to be that way. But let him that is the greatest among YOU become as the youngest, and the one acting as chief as the one ministering.

26007.label: Luke 22:27
26007.text: For which one is greater, the one reclining at the table or the one ministering? Is it not the one reclining at the table? But I am in YOUR midst as the one ministering.

26008.label: Luke 22:28
26008.text: “However, YOU are the ones that have stuck with me in my trials;

26009.label: Luke 22:29
26009.text: and I make a covenant with YOU, just as my Father has made a covenant with me, for a kingdom,

26010.label: Luke 22:30
26010.text: that YOU may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

26011.label: Luke 22:31
26011.text: “Simon, Simon, look! Satan has demanded to have YOU men to sift YOU as wheat.

26012.label: Luke 22:32
26012.text: But I have made supplication for you that your faith may not give out; and you, when once you have returned, strengthen your brothers.”

26013.label: Luke 22:33
26013.text: Then he said to him: “Lord, I am ready to go with you both into prison and into death.”

26014.label: Luke 22:34
26014.text: But he said: “I tell you, Peter, A cock will not crow today until you have three times denied knowing me.”

26015.label: Luke 22:35
26015.text: He also said to them: “When I sent YOU forth without purse and food pouch and sandals, YOU did not want for anything, did YOU?” They said: “No!”

26016.label: Luke 22:36
26016.text: Then he said to them: “But now let the one that has a purse take it up, likewise also a food pouch; and let the one having no sword sell his outer garment and buy one.

26017.label: Luke 22:37
26017.text: For I tell YOU that this which is written must be accomplished in me, namely, ‘And he was reckoned with lawless ones.’ For that which concerns me is having an accomplishment.”

26018.label: Luke 22:38
26018.text: Then they said: “Lord, look! here are two swords.” He said to them: “It is enough.”

26019.label: Luke 22:39
26019.text: On going out he went as customarily to the Mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.

26020.label: Luke 22:40
26020.text: Having come to the place he said to them: “Carry on prayer, that YOU do not enter into temptation.”

26021.label: Luke 22:41
26021.text: And he himself drew away from them about a stone’s throw, and bent his knees and began to pray,

26022.label: Luke 22:42
26022.text: saying: “Father, if you wish, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, let, not my will, but yours take place.”

26023.label: Luke 22:43
26023.text: Then an angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

26024.label: Luke 22:44
26024.text: But getting into an agony he continued praying more earnestly; and his sweat became as drops of blood falling to the ground.

26025.label: Luke 22:45
26025.text: And he rose from prayer, went to the disciples and found them slumbering from grief;

26026.label: Luke 22:46
26026.text: and he said to them: “Why are YOU sleeping? Rise and carry on prayer, that YOU do not enter into temptation.”

26027.label: Luke 22:47
26027.text: While he was yet speaking, look! a crowd, and the [man] called Judas, one of the twelve, was going before them; and he approached Jesus to kiss him.

26028.label: Luke 22:48
26028.text: But Jesus said to him: “Judas, do you betray the Son of man with a kiss?”

26029.label: Luke 22:49
26029.text: When those about him saw what was going to happen, they said: “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

26030.label: Luke 22:50
26030.text: A certain one of them even did strike the slave of the high priest and took off his right ear.

26031.label: Luke 22:51
26031.text: But in reply Jesus said: “LET it go as far as this.” And he touched the ear and healed him.

26032.label: Luke 22:52
26032.text: Jesus then said to the chief priests and captains of the temple and older men that had come there for him: “Did YOU come out with swords and clubs as against a robber?

26033.label: Luke 22:53
26033.text: While I was with YOU in the temple day after day YOU did not stretch out YOUR hands against me. But this is YOUR hour and the authority of darkness.”

26034.label: Luke 22:54
26034.text: Then they arrested him and led him off and brought him into the house of the high priest; but Peter was following at a distance.

26035.label: Luke 22:55
26035.text: When they lit a fire in the midst of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter was sitting in among them.

26036.label: Luke 22:56
26036.text: But a certain servant girl saw him sitting by the bright fire and looked him over and said: “This man also was with him.”

26037.label: Luke 22:57
26037.text: But he denied it, saying: “I do not know him, woman.”

26038.label: Luke 22:58
26038.text: And after a short time another person seeing him said: “You also are one of them.” But Peter said: “Man, I am not.”

26039.label: Luke 22:59
26039.text: And after about an hour intervened a certain other [man] began insisting strongly: “For a certainty this [man] also was with him; for, in fact, he is a Gal·i·leʹan!”

26040.label: Luke 22:60
26040.text: But Peter said: “Man, I do not know what you are saying.” And instantly, while he was yet speaking, a cock crowed.

26041.label: Luke 22:61
26041.text: And the Lord turned and looked upon Peter, and Peter recalled the utterance of the Lord when he said to him: “Before a cock crows today you will disown me three times.”

26042.label: Luke 22:62
26042.text: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

26043.label: Luke 22:63
26043.text: Now the men that had him in custody began to make fun of him, hitting him;

26044.label: Luke 22:64
26044.text: and after covering him over they would ask and say: “Prophesy. Who is it that struck you?”

26045.label: Luke 22:65
26045.text: And they went on saying many other things in blasphemy against him.

26046.label: Luke 22:66
26046.text: At length when it became day, the assembly of older men of the people, both chief priests and scribes, gathered together, and they haled him into their Sanʹhe·drin hall, saying:

26047.label: Luke 22:67
26047.text: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them: “Even if I told YOU, YOU would not believe it at all.

26048.label: Luke 22:68
26048.text: Moreover, if I questioned YOU, YOU would not answer at all.

26049.label: Luke 22:69
26049.text: However, from now on the Son of man will be sitting at the powerful right hand of God.”

26050.label: Luke 22:70
26050.text: At this they all said: “Are you, therefore, the Son of God?” He said to them: “YOU yourselves are saying that I am.”

26051.label: Luke 22:71
26051.text: They said: “Why do we need further witness? For we ourselves have heard [it] out of his own mouth.”

26052.label: Luke 23:1
26052.text: So the multitude of them rose, one and all, and led him to Pilate.

26053.label: Luke 23:2
26053.text: Then they started to accuse him, saying: “This man we found subverting our nation and forbidding the paying of taxes to Caesar and saying he himself is Christ a king.”

26054.label: Luke 23:3
26054.text: Now Pilate asked him the question: “Are you the king of the Jews?” In answer to him he said: “You yourself are saying [it].”

26055.label: Luke 23:4
26055.text: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds: “I find no crime in this man.”

26056.label: Luke 23:5
26056.text: But they began to be insistent, saying: “He stirs up the people by teaching throughout all Ju·deʹa, even starting out from Galʹi·lee to here.”

26057.label: Luke 23:6
26057.text: On hearing that, Pilate asked whether the man was a Gal·i·leʹan,

26058.label: Luke 23:7
26058.text: and, after ascertaining that he was from the jurisdiction of Herod, he sent him on to Herod, who was also himself in Jerusalem in these days.

26059.label: Luke 23:8
26059.text: When Herod saw Jesus he rejoiced greatly, for over a considerable time he was wanting to see him because of having heard about him, and he was hoping to see some sign performed by him.

26060.label: Luke 23:9
26060.text: Now he began to question him with a good many words; but he made him no answer.

26061.label: Luke 23:10
26061.text: However, the chief priests and the scribes kept standing up and vehemently accusing him.

26062.label: Luke 23:11
26062.text: Then Herod together with his soldier guards discredited him, and he made fun of him by clothing him with a bright garment and sent him back to Pilate.

26063.label: Luke 23:12
26063.text: Both Herod and Pilate now became friends with each other on that very day; for before that they had continued at enmity between themselves.

26064.label: Luke 23:13
26064.text: Pilate then called the chief priests and the rulers and the people together

26065.label: Luke 23:14
26065.text: and said to them: “YOU brought this man to me as one inciting the people to revolt, and, look! I examined him in front of YOU but found in this man no ground for the charges YOU are bringing against him.

26066.label: Luke 23:15
26066.text: In fact, neither did Herod, for he sent him back to us; and, look! nothing deserving of death has been committed by him.

26067.label: Luke 23:16
26067.text: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

26069.label: Luke 23:18
26069.text: But with their whole multitude they cried out, saying: “Take this one away, but release Bar·abʹbas to us!”

26070.label: Luke 23:19
26070.text: (Which [man] had been thrown into prison for a certain sedition occurring in the city and for murder.)

26071.label: Luke 23:20
26071.text: Again Pilate called out to them, because he wanted to release Jesus.

26072.label: Luke 23:21
26072.text: Then they began to yell, saying: “Impale! Impale him!”

26073.label: Luke 23:22
26073.text: The third time he said to them: “Why, what bad thing did this [man] do? I found nothing deserving of death in him; I will therefore chastise and release him.”

26074.label: Luke 23:23
26074.text: At this they began to be urgent, with loud voices, demanding that he be impaled; and their voices began to win out.

26075.label: Luke 23:24
26075.text: So Pilate gave sentence for their demand to be met:

26076.label: Luke 23:25
26076.text: he released the man that had been thrown into prison for sedition and murder and whom they were demanding, but he surrendered Jesus to their will.

26077.label: Luke 23:26
26077.text: Now as they led him away, they laid hold of Simon, a certain native of Cy·reʹne, coming from the country, and they placed the torture stake upon him to bear it behind Jesus.

26078.label: Luke 23:27
26078.text: But there was following him a great multitude of the people and of women who kept beating themselves in grief and bewailing him.

26079.label: Luke 23:28
26079.text: Jesus turned to the women and said: “Daughters of Jerusalem, stop weeping for me. On the contrary, weep for yourselves and for YOUR children;

26080.label: Luke 23:29
26080.text: because, look! days are coming in which people will say, ‘Happy are the barren women, and the wombs that did not give birth and the breasts that did not nurse!’

26081.label: Luke 23:30
26081.text: Then they will start to say to the mountains, ‘Fall over us!’ and to the hills, ‘Cover us over!’

26082.label: Luke 23:31
26082.text: Because if they do these things when the tree is moist, what will occur when it is withered?”

26083.label: Luke 23:32
26083.text: But two other men, evildoers, were also being led to be executed with him.

26084.label: Luke 23:33
26084.text: And when they got to the place called Skull, there they impaled him and the evildoers, one on his right and one on his left.

26085.label: Luke 23:34
26085.text: [[But Jesus was saying: “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”]] Furthermore, to distribute his garments, they cast lots.

26086.label: Luke 23:35
26086.text: And the people stood looking on. But the rulers were sneering, saying: “Others he saved; let him save himself, if this one is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”

26087.label: Luke 23:36
26087.text: Even the soldiers made fun of him, coming close and offering him sour wine

26088.label: Luke 23:37
26088.text: and saying: “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.”

26089.label: Luke 23:38
26089.text: There was also an inscription over him: “This is the king of the Jews.”

26090.label: Luke 23:39
26090.text: But one of the hung evildoers began to say abusively to him: “You are the Christ, are you not? Save yourself and us.”

26091.label: Luke 23:40
26091.text: In reply the other rebuked him and said: “Do you not fear God at all, now that you are in the same judgment?

26092.label: Luke 23:41
26092.text: And we, indeed, justly so, for we are receiving in full what we deserve for things we did; but this [man] did nothing out of the way.”

26093.label: Luke 23:42
26093.text: And he went on to say: “Jesus, remember me when you get into your kingdom.”

26094.label: Luke 23:43
26094.text: And he said to him: “Truly I tell you today, You will be with me in Paradise.”

26095.label: Luke 23:44
26095.text: Well, by now it was about the sixth hour, and yet a darkness fell over all the earth until the ninth hour,

26096.label: Luke 23:45
26096.text: because the sunlight failed; then the curtain of the sanctuary was rent down the middle.

26097.label: Luke 23:46
26097.text: And Jesus called with a loud voice and said: “Father, into your hands I entrust my spirit.” When he had said this, he expired.

26098.label: Luke 23:47
26098.text: Because of seeing what occurred the army officer began to glorify God, saying: “Really this man was righteous.”

26099.label: Luke 23:48
26099.text: And all the crowds that were gathered together there for this spectacle, when they beheld the things that occurred, began to return, beating their breasts.

26100.label: Luke 23:49
26100.text: Moreover, all those acquainted with him were standing at a distance. Also, women, who together had followed him from Galʹi·lee, were standing beholding these things.

26101.label: Luke 23:50
26101.text: And, look! a man named Joseph, who was a member of the Council, a good and righteous man —

26102.label: Luke 23:51
26102.text: this [man] had not voted in support of their design and action —he was from Ar·i·ma·theʹa, a city of the Ju·deʹans, and was waiting for the kingdom of God;

26103.label: Luke 23:52
26103.text: this man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

26104.label: Luke 23:53
26104.text: And he took it down and wrapped it up in fine linen, and he laid him in a tomb carved in the rock, in which no man had yet lain.

26105.label: Luke 23:54
26105.text: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the evening light of the sabbath was approaching.

26106.label: Luke 23:55
26106.text: But the women, who had come with him out of Galʹi·lee, followed along and took a look at the memorial tomb and how his body was laid;

26107.label: Luke 23:56
26107.text: and they went back to prepare spices and perfumed oils. But, of course, they rested on the sabbath according to the commandment.

26108.label: Luke 24:1
26108.text: On the first day of the week, however, they went very early to the tomb, bearing the spices they had prepared.

26109.label: Luke 24:2
26109.text: But they found the stone rolled away from the memorial tomb,

26110.label: Luke 24:3
26110.text: and when they entered they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

26111.label: Luke 24:4
26111.text: While they were in perplexity over this, look! two men in flashing clothing stood by them.

26112.label: Luke 24:5
26112.text: As the [women] became frightened and kept their faces turned to the ground, the [men] said to them: “Why are YOU looking for the living One among the dead?

26113.label: Luke 24:6
26113.text: [[He is not here, but has been raised up.]] Recall how he spoke to YOU while he was yet in Galʹi·lee,

26114.label: Luke 24:7
26114.text: saying that the Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men and be impaled and yet on the third day rise.”

26115.label: Luke 24:8
26115.text: So they called his sayings to mind,

26116.label: Luke 24:9
26116.text: and they returned from the memorial tomb and reported all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

26117.label: Luke 24:10
26117.text: They were the Magʹda·lene Mary, and Jo·anʹna, and Mary the [mother] of James. Also, the rest of the women with them were telling the apostles these things.

26118.label: Luke 24:11
26118.text: However, these sayings appeared as nonsense to them and they would not believe the [women].

26119.label: Luke 24:12
26119.text: [[But Peter rose and ran to the memorial tomb, and, stooping forward, he beheld the bandages alone. So he went off, wondering within himself at what had occurred.]]

26120.label: Luke 24:13
26120.text: But, look! on that very day two of them were journeying to a village about seven miles distant from Jerusalem [and] named Em·maʹus,

26121.label: Luke 24:14
26121.text: and they were conversing with each other over all these things that had come about.

26122.label: Luke 24:15
26122.text: Now as they were conversing and discussing, Jesus himself approached and began walking with them;

26123.label: Luke 24:16
26123.text: but their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

26124.label: Luke 24:17
26124.text: He said to them: “What are these matters that YOU are debating between yourselves as YOU walk along?” And they stood still with sad faces.

26125.label: Luke 24:18
26125.text: In answer the one named Cleʹo·pas said to him: “Are you dwelling as an alien by yourself in Jerusalem and so do not know the things that have occurred in her in these days?”

26126.label: Luke 24:19
26126.text: And he said to them: “What things?” They said to him: “The things concerning Jesus the Naz·a·reneʹ, who became a prophet powerful in work and word before God and all the people;

26127.label: Luke 24:20
26127.text: and how our chief priests and rulers handed him over to the sentence of death and impaled him.

26128.label: Luke 24:21
26128.text: But we were hoping that this [man] was the one destined to deliver Israel; yes, and besides all these things, this makes the third day since these things occurred.

26129.label: Luke 24:22
26129.text: Moreover, certain women from among us also astonished us, because they had been early to the memorial tomb

26130.label: Luke 24:23
26130.text: but did not find his body and they came saying they had also seen a supernatural sight of angels, who said he is alive.

26131.label: Luke 24:24
26131.text: Further, some of those with us went off to the memorial tomb; and they found it so, just as the women had said, but they did not see him.”

26132.label: Luke 24:25
26132.text: So he said to them: “O senseless ones and slow in heart to believe on all the things the prophets spoke!

26133.label: Luke 24:26
26133.text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

26134.label: Luke 24:27
26134.text: And commencing at Moses and all the Prophets he interpreted to them things pertaining to himself in all the Scriptures.

26135.label: Luke 24:28
26135.text: Finally they got close to the village where they were journeying, and he made as if he was journeying on farther.

26136.label: Luke 24:29
26136.text: But they used pressure upon him, saying: “Stay with us, because it is toward evening and the day has already declined.” With that he went in to stay with them.

26137.label: Luke 24:30
26137.text: And as he was reclining with them at the meal he took the loaf, blessed it, broke it and began to hand it to them.

26138.label: Luke 24:31
26138.text: At that their eyes were fully opened and they recognized him; and he disappeared from them.

26139.label: Luke 24:32
26139.text: And they said to each other: “Were not our hearts burning as he was speaking to us on the road, as he was fully opening up the Scriptures to us?”

26140.label: Luke 24:33
26140.text: And in that very hour they rose and returned to Jerusalem, and they found the eleven and those with them assembled together,

26141.label: Luke 24:34
26141.text: saying: “For a fact the Lord was raised up and he appeared to Simon!”

26142.label: Luke 24:35
26142.text: Now they themselves related the [events] on the road and how he became known to them by the breaking of the loaf.

26143.label: Luke 24:36
26143.text: While they were speaking of these things he himself stood in their midst [[and said to them: “May YOU have peace.”]]

26144.label: Luke 24:37
26144.text: But because they were terrified, and had become frightened, they were imagining they beheld a spirit.

26145.label: Luke 24:38
26145.text: So he said to them: “Why are YOU troubled, and why is it doubts come up in YOUR hearts?

26146.label: Luke 24:39
26146.text: See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself; feel me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones just as YOU behold that I have.”

26147.label: Luke 24:40
26147.text: [[And as he said this he showed them his hands and his feet.]]

26148.label: Luke 24:41
26148.text: But while they were still not believing for sheer joy and were wondering, he said to them: “Do YOU have something there to eat?”

26149.label: Luke 24:42
26149.text: And they handed him a piece of broiled fish;

26150.label: Luke 24:43
26150.text: and he took it and ate it before their eyes.

26151.label: Luke 24:44
26151.text: He now said to them: “These are my words which I spoke to YOU while I was yet with YOU, that all the things written in the law of Moses and in the Prophets and Psalms about me must be fulfilled.”

26152.label: Luke 24:45
26152.text: Then he opened up their minds fully to grasp the meaning of the Scriptures,

26153.label: Luke 24:46
26153.text: and he said to them: “In this way it is written that the Christ would suffer and rise from among the dead on the third day,

26154.label: Luke 24:47
26154.text: and on the basis of his name repentance for forgiveness of sins would be preached in all the nations —starting out from Jerusalem,

26155.label: Luke 24:48
26155.text: YOU are to be witnesses of these things.

26156.label: Luke 24:49
26156.text: And, look! I am sending forth upon YOU that which is promised by my Father. YOU, though, abide in the city until YOU become clothed with power from on high.”

26157.label: Luke 24:50
26157.text: But he led them out as far as Bethʹa·ny, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

26158.label: Luke 24:51
26158.text: As he was blessing them he was parted from them and began to be borne up to heaven.

26159.label: Luke 24:52
26159.text: And they did obeisance to him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

26160.label: Luke 24:53
26160.text: And they were continually in the temple blessing God.
